title: Settings
description: Configure the DeepSeek model, defaults for new research tasks, and your research companion.

deepseek.sectionDescription: Manage the DeepSeek API key used by the local research Agent.
deepseek.setupDescription: Save a DeepSeek API key before first use. The service does not need to restart.
deepseek.deepSeekOnly: This field requires an API key created for DeepSeek models. The key is stored in this project's local .env file.
deepseek.replaceKeyPlaceholder: Enter a new DeepSeek API key
deepseek.keyNotReturned: For security, the current key is never read back or displayed. Leaving this blank keeps the existing configuration.
deepseek.saveError: The API key could not be saved. Check the local backend and try again.
deepseek.unavailableDescription: The local backend is required to check or save the DeepSeek API key.
deepseek.unavailableError: The local backend could not be reached. Start it and try again.

research.title: Research defaults
research.description: These values initialize new tasks. Changes made in the composer only affect that task.
research.maxPapersError: Enter a whole number from 1 to 50.

pet.title: Research companion
pet.description: The companion reflects the active Agent stage and opens this page when clicked.
pet.preview: Preview: {visibility}, {size}, {motion} motion. Changes apply after saving.
